abyss/cross_section_diagram.title: Waterproof Diaphragm Box
abyss/cross_section_diagram.quote: To keep the surrounding soil from collapsing and the Rhine’s high water table from flooding the pit, engineers constructed a massive underground box using reinforced concrete diaphragm walls.
abyss/cross_section_diagram.brief: A cross-section shows the Rhine river level, the high water table, and the concrete walls acting as a barrier preventing water ingress into the dry pit.

abyss/defect_cutaway.title: Hidden Structural Void
abyss/defect_cutaway.quote: Instead of halting the pour to clear the blockage, the crew made a decision that would remain hidden beneath ninety feet of earth for five years: they poured the concrete anyway, leaving a pocket of l
abyss/defect_cutaway.brief: A close-up cross-section reveals the concrete wall with a visible pocket of loose gravel and mud where the concrete failed to fill the gap.

abyss/pour_sequence_animation.title: Failed Concrete Pour
abyss/pour_sequence_animation.quote: Concrete poured over the mud, capping it like liquid stone over a soft core of silt and loose gravel.
abyss/pour_sequence_animation.brief: An animation shows the tremie pipe failing to displace mud, resulting in a concrete layer sitting on top of an unstable, unreinforced sediment base.

abyss/erosion_void_diagram.title: Subsurface Erosion Void
abyss/erosion_void_diagram.quote: That is eighty cubic meters of empty space now sitting directly beneath the foundations of the adjacent Cologne Historical Archive.
abyss/erosion_void_diagram.brief: A 3D cross-section shows the building foundation with a growing, empty cavern underneath it as sand is pumped out of the nearby pit.

abyss/pressure_force_diagram.title: Hydrostatic Pressure Failure
abyss/pressure_force_diagram.quote: Groundwater from the Rhine, elevated by heavy seasonal rainfall, exerted a hydrostatic pressure head exceeding 2.8 bar against the outer face of slurry wall panel eleven.
abyss/pressure_force_diagram.brief: Arrows represent the immense water pressure pushing against the wall, highlighting the localized structural failure at the joint.

abyss/soil_liquefaction_flow.title: Ground Liquefaction Process
abyss/soil_liquefaction_flow.quote: The excavation shaft acted like an unpaved drain, pulling the ground from under Severinstraße at a rate of several metric tons per second.
abyss/soil_liquefaction_flow.brief: A cross-section shows soil particles losing friction and flowing like a liquid from under the building into the open construction pit.

home-vault/chemical_signaling_diagram.title: The Rodent Chemical Highway
home-vault/chemical_signaling_diagram.quote: The grease contains pheromones that tell every other rodent in the colony exactly who passed by, when they passed, and whether they found food at the end of the hall.
home-vault/chemical_signaling_diagram.brief: A cross-section of a baseboard shows glowing pheromone particles being deposited by a mouse, with icons representing 'Time,' 'Identity,' and 'Food Source' floating in the grease trail.

home-vault/thermal_attraction_map.title: Foam Acts as Heat Beacon
home-vault/thermal_attraction_map.quote: Instead of blocking the rodent, that warm foam patch acts like a radiant heat beacon in sub-zero weather, pulling mice from twenty feet away straight toward the exact point you tried to seal.
home-vault/thermal_attraction_map.brief: A thermal imaging view of a house wall showing the foam plug glowing bright red, with arrows indicating mice outside being drawn toward the heat source.

home-vault/thermal_draft_diagram.title: The Kitchen Chimney Effect
home-vault/thermal_draft_diagram.quote: The continuous heat generated by the refrigerator compressor creates a natural chimney effect, pulling draft air up from under your subfloor and sweeping it into the kitchen.
home-vault/thermal_draft_diagram.brief: A cross-section of a kitchen showing warm air rising from the floor behind a refrigerator, with swirling arrows demonstrating the airflow that carries scent trails.
